courses.name: Intermediate Work Zone Traffic Control (WZTC)
courses.exLoc: Canvas · VCCS testing center or remote (Respondus LockDown Browser)
courses.steps: Work through the materials at your own pace (about 16 hours), then take the exam by Oct 31. Technical requirements are listed in Canvas.
courses.about: Students are taught concepts, techniques and practices in the installation and maintenance of traffic control devices, specific to the Commonwealth of Virginia, legal aspects of temporary traffic control, installation and removal procedures, flagging procedures, and other considerations such as pedestrians, nighttime work, and urban areas.  Several presentations included in this course are designed to provide experience in designing temporary traffic control set ups for various real-life situations and recognizing, analyzing, and correcting deficiencies.
